description: Glowmere at a sixth of its density: the floor of the renderer laboratory's ladder (docs/renderer-2-benchmark-world.md). Every density weight is the shipped glowmere recipe's multiplied by 0.40, which multiplies every layer's density by 0.16 and leaves the proportions between the species exactly as they were -- the same valley, the same air, the same light, thinned. Art direction, seed, extent, negative space and focal strength are identical to glowmere-medium, so the two are the same shot and differ only in how much grows in it.
